title: B-tree temporary-space release

scope.rationale: The B-tree shared owner now has the source destructor for its offset temporary cell buffer, consumed when page size changes.

external_source_responsibilities: B-tree shared allocator and temporary-space allocation
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete nullable destructor is translated and called by page-size replacement.

outputs: Temporary allocation released and nullable owner cleared
contracts.ownership: Consumes the complete backing allocation, including the four-byte prefix represented by the owning slice.
contracts.state_and_results: Null is a no-op; non-null is freed exactly once.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O; caller owns B-tree synchronization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Destructor allocates nothing and cannot fail.

representation_differences: The owning Zig slice retains the original allocation base, so no pointer subtraction is needed before free.

oracle.protocol: Allocate temporary space, release twice, and replace page size.

assurance.continuation: A later allocation may recreate the buffer.

integration.bounded_owner_retired: Inline page-size cleanup replaced by the source-shaped helper.

known_blockers: Route final B-tree close through helper and focused allocator trace.

callers: B-tree page-size replacement and future close
